raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Background

Copy #6335 at pinned source head `dc06593d36fd8c580cceb7d8e4b12cf226c042db` onto `main`.

## What changed

Use GitHub App authentication in the code-freeze workflow, including its App-token job, and update the shared workflow pin.

## Details

Both source commits retain cherry-pick provenance. Only `.github/workflows/release-freeze.yml` differs; its final blob matches the pinned source.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Dispatch --> Freeze[Pinned code-freeze workflow]
  App[GitHub App credentials] --> Freeze
  App --> Token[App-token step]
  Token --> Followup[Repository follow-up steps]
```

## Tested

- Native changed-file pre-commit completed; nonmatching hooks skipped natively.
- Diff whitespace, source identity, signatures, signoffs, and remote head verified.
- ML/GPU tests excluded: product/dependency inputs unchanged.
- actionlint unavailable due denied asset access. No release dispatched locally. Required CI and secret-plumbing approval pending.

files.patch:
@@ -32,10 +32,15 @@ on:
         description: Dry-run of code-freeze
         required: false
         default: true
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
 jobs:
   code-freeze:
-    uses: NVIDIA-NeMo/FW-CI-templates/.github/workflows/_code_freeze.yml@bfdb5e35067fd8cd91ce21fca4eb1072ffd7ab8c # v1.4.2
+    uses: NVIDIA-NeMo/FW-CI-templates/.github/workflows/_code_freeze.yml@61445a177938967f70c94094b98402e979452151 # github app authentication
     with:
+      app-id: ${{ vars.BOT_ID }}
+      environment-name: main
       library-name: Megatron-Bridge
       python-package: megatron.bridge
       has-src-dir: true
@@ -44,11 +49,10 @@ jobs:
       dry-run: ${{ inputs.dry-run }}
       next-pre-release: ""
       next-dev: ""
-      use-pat: true
     secrets:
       SLACK_WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.SLACK_MAIN_CHANNEL_WEBHOOK }}
       SLACK_WEBHOOK_ADMIN: ${{ secrets.SLACK_TEAM_GROUP_ID }}
-      PAT: ${{ secrets.PAT }}
+      BOT_KEY: ${{ secrets.BOT_KEY }}
 
   bump-docs-versions:
     needs: [code-freeze]
@@ -57,11 +61,20 @@ jobs:
       VERSION: ${{ needs.code-freeze.outputs.release-branch }}
       DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry-run }}
     steps:
+      - name: Generate GitHub App token
+        id: app-token
+        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
+        with:
+          app-id: ${{ vars.BOT_ID }}
+          private-key: ${{ secrets.BOT_KEY }}
+          permission-contents: write
+          permission-administration: write
+
       - name: Checkout repository
         uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
         with:
           ref: main
-          token: ${{ secrets.PAT }}
+          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
 
       - name: Configure git
         run: |
